chunks: Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from ʿAlī ibn Muḥammad ibn Bundār, from Ibrāhīm ibn Isḥāq al-Aḥmar, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Ḥammād al-Anṣārī, from Mufaḍḍal ibn ʿUmar, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning:

About a man who had intercourse with his wife while she was fasting and he was fasting, he said: “If he forced her, then two expiations are upon him. If she consented to him, then one expiation is upon him and one expiation is upon her. And if he compelled her, then upon him is a flogging of fifty lashes, half of the hadd. And if she consented to him, he is flogged twenty-five lashes and she is flogged twenty-five lashes.”

key_terms.اسْتَكْرَهَهَا: he forced her against her will
key_terms.كَفَّارَةٌ: a single expiation required for violating the fast
key_terms.كَفَّارَتَانِ: two expiations required as legal compensation
key_terms.نِصْفِ الْحَدِّ: half of the prescribed hadd punishment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a husband has intercourse with his wife while both are fasting?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding a fasting husband and wife who engage in intercourse during the fast. It distinguishes between coercion and mutual consent, assigning kaffarah and corporal punishment accordingly, and thus addresses both the sanctity of fasting and responsibility within marital conduct.
